name: Kairos Academy Green
confirmedFacts: Kairos Academy Green is the only Counter-Strike academy team.
The team is pre-competitive and training.
The Academy is a developmental pathway into Kairos Counter-Strike.
No captain has been assigned.
No official match has been played.
The official competitive debut is planned for February 2027.
Main-team players do not participate in Academy scouting or recruitment.
Academy scouting is handled by management, scouting staff, analysts, and canonically confirmed Academy coaching staff.
The next competitive milestone is February 2027.

The Academy roster currently contains RAMENSOUP (formerly soupcrime), velcroDAWG (formerly velcrodog), p4rkingl0t (formerly parkinglot), dentalplan, and wrongnumber; the three renames became current 2027-01-04.
All five players are American minors living in California.
All five are 15 or 16 years old at selection.
No exact Academy player date of birth is confirmed.

As of episode-091/episode-093, current roles are: RAMENSOUP IGL / Rifler, velcroDAWG Entry Rifler, p4rkingl0t Lurker / Rifler, dentalplan Primary AWPer, wrongnumber Anchor / Support Rifler. These are current, not necessarily permanent, assignments.
No captain, substitute, or starter hierarchy beyond the above is assigned; the captaincy remains explicitly TBD.
Jake “Stewie2K” Yip is active Head Coach beginning 2026-11-23.
Ethan “Trace” Miller is active Development Coach beginning 2026-11-23.
The current narrative date is 2027-01-04.
Tarik is appointed Head Coach of Kairos Academy Green on 2027-01-28 after Stewie2K announces his departure to Without a Roof; Trace remains Development Coach and the five Academy players remain.
Evan acts as IGL; no captain has been designated.
unconfirmedDetails: The exact competitive milestone date in February 2027 is TBD.
Future academy tournaments, partner leagues, results, achievements, and statistics are TBD.
Player contract status and terms are TBD.
canonNotes: A planned February 2027 debut is not an official match or confirmed competition entry.
The earlier 16-18 Academy eligibility rule is superseded by the Episode 63-74 15-16 selection policy.
The five selected players are not assigned to the former planned role template.
Main-team players did not select Academy candidates.
Current roles were assigned episode-091 (vote) and reconfirmed episode-093; do not infer or assign a captain from the IGL role or any other reason.

Do not change the current nicknames RAMENSOUP, velcroDAWG, and p4rkingl0t when referring to episode-093 or later; use the historical nicknames soupcrime, velcrodog, and parkinglot only for episodes before 2027-01-04.
